description.en: Inatter is the game's in-game social feed (its posts are listed in data/res/history/tweets_config.cfg.bin). Unless global bit flag 1418 is already set, it looks in the loaded file for an entry matching the current game sub-phase (the value CMND_GET_GAME_SUB_PHASE returns). If there is one, it sets global bit flag 1418, which by the name of the command marks new posts. It then frees the loaded file.

Always false.
null if the script system is not ready.
